items.title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
items.summary: Every one of these five bank stocks slashed its dividend in the financial crisis, yet a new rate cycle may be rewarding patient holders. Only one has stopped raising its payout, and another carries a hidden capital risk worth knowing about.

items.title: JPMorgan Reveals Cause of Banking Outage That Disrupted U.S. Customers
items.summary: A technical failure disrupted online banking and transfers, with JPMorgan ruling out a cyberattack.

items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $210,000 Salary With Dividends?
items.summary: The same $210,000 paycheck can cost you $2 million or $6 million in capital, depending on one number. One high-yield holding just slashed its payout, and it shows why chasing the cheapest route can backfire.
